properties.description: Successful creation followed within 30 minutes by publication of the same observed BotId by the same UPN in the same environment, without an enabled matching maker approval. Includes unregistered agents; inventory enriches registration status only.
properties.displayName: AI Agent | Agent rapidly created and published by an unapproved maker
properties.query:
// Uses observed BotId even when unregistered; inventory only enriches registration status.
let Agents = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentInventory')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) | distinct AgentId
    | extend RegistrationStatus = 'Registered';
let Approved = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentApprovedMakers')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project ActorUPN = tolower(tostring(ActorUPN)), ApprovedEnvironment = tolower(tostring(EnvironmentId))
    | where isnotempty(ActorUPN) and isnotempty(ApprovedEnvironment);
let Events = PowerPlatformAdminActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
    | where EventResult == 'Succeeded'
    | where EventOriginalType in ('BotCreate', 'BotUpdateOperation-BotPublish')
    | extend AgentId = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Properties.BotId), tostring(PropertyCollection.BotId))),
             ActorUPN = tolower(tostring(ActorName)), Environment = tolower(tostring(EnvironmentId))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) and ActorUPN contains '@' and isnotempty(Environment) and isnotempty(EventOriginalUid)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventOriginalUid
    | join kind=leftouter Agents on AgentId
    | extend RegistrationStatus = coalesce(RegistrationStatus, 'Unknown');
let Created = Events | where EventOriginalType == 'BotCreate'
    | project AgentId, ActorUPN, Environment, CreatedAt = TimeGenerated, CreateEventId = tostring(EventOriginalUid);
let Published = Events | where EventOriginalType == 'BotUpdateOperation-BotPublish'
    | project AgentId, ActorUPN, Environment, RegistrationStatus, PublishedAt = TimeGenerated, PublishEventId = tostring(EventOriginalUid);
let ExactApproval = Approved | where ApprovedEnvironment != '*'
    | project ActorUPN, Environment = ApprovedEnvironment;
let GlobalApproval = Approved | where ApprovedEnvironment == '*' | distinct ActorUPN;
Created
| join kind=inner Published on AgentId, ActorUPN, Environment
| where PublishedAt >= CreatedAt and PublishedAt <= CreatedAt + 30m
| join kind=leftanti ExactApproval on ActorUPN, Environment
| join kind=leftanti GlobalApproval on ActorUPN
| summarize arg_max(CreatedAt, *) by AgentId, ActorUPN, Environment, PublishEventId
| project TimeGenerated = PublishedAt, AgentId, ActorUPN, EnvironmentId = Environment, RegistrationStatus,
          Evidence = tostring(bag_pack('createEventId', CreateEventId, 'publishEventId', PublishEventId, 'createdAt', CreatedAt, 'publishedAt', PublishedAt)),
          CorrelationQuality = 'exact', AccountCustomEntity = ActorUPN
